children: Voyager Technologies reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $88.72 million, up 124.1% from the prior-year quarter, while net loss available to common shareholders widened to $55.68 million and diluted loss per share was $0.91.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net loss available to common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per common share”.
U.S. government program revenue reached $78.6 million, while commercial and international sales totaled $10.1 million.
Voyager advanced its lunar infrastructure strategy, including Astrobotic’s end-to-end lander and infrastructure business.
NASA had funded $212.5 million of its $217.5 million Starlab development grant. Voyager plans to operate the station through its joint venture.
Backlog reached $742.1 million, including $390.3 million funded. Management expects continued investment in production, technology and growth.
